none: PAS NLM-651992: Roman Nummus of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus. Issue of 379-387, Reece Period 20, possibly Valentinian II (375-392). Obverse description: Bust diademed and draped right Reverse description: Emperor left raising kneeling figure. Reverse inscription: [R]EPARA[TIO REIPUB] Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.90, Weight: 2.94gms, die axis: 6
